method: Inspection of saved diagnostic outcomes, objection targets, witness sets and confirmation reasons. Structural results are separated from factual inference.
diagnosis: The critic repeatedly labels answer/source comparisons as cross_source_conflict without two distinct passage witnesses. The added guard correctly refuses those incomplete conflict confirmations but contributes to an unusably inconclusive audit. No improved factual error detection is demonstrated.
decision: Freeze this diagnostic. Evaluate preserved baseline answer generation on fresh fixed contexts without using a model gate to approve candidates.
limits: No count of inconclusive outputs is interpreted as correct answers or as successful factual detection. Source-based project assessment is not independent human validation.
